lineage.source_license: MPL-2.0, retained verbatim in the public image notices
lineage.selection: Distinct nontrivial Mozilla query files, with publisher schemas for every base table.
lineage.transform: SQL bytes unchanged. Publisher RECORD/REPEATED schemas become STRUCT/ARRAY types. Implicit project/dataset use the publisher query directory.
lineage.deduplication: Reject identical raw/parsed SQL and related identifier/literal-normalized templates against all public inputs and within private.
lineage.eligibility: Complete lineage graph with roots, no errors/logs/warnings.
lineage.split_rule: SQLGlot/SQLMesh public, Mozilla private within this lineage workload.
lineage.rationale: Keep the original conversion family unchanged while evaluating the new optimizer on a separate private origin.
lineage.limitations: Development corpus, not an official qualification or timing admission.

aggregate.split_rule: Origin-disjoint within the optimizer family, not across different workload families.
aggregate.original_conversion_origin_overlap: Mozilla origin retained unchanged in the original conversion family.

previous_archive.selection: Parent before the 100 most recent SQL-directory commits at the already pinned current revision

original.source_rule: Same real file at two pinned repository revisions.
original.operation: Full existing structural-diff contract with explicit source dialect.

diff.rule: All compatible changed files in the next100 SQL-directory commits. No file reused.
